Before the museum [will reopen], curators had cleaned every painting in the east wing.

Which choice is the best version of the bracketed portion? (Choose NO CHANGE if it is best as written.)

choices.rationale: This form does not place the action in the past alongside the main clause.
The present tense does not fit a sequence of two past events.
The past perfect belongs to the earlier action, which the main clause already has.
Correct. The later of the two past actions takes the simple past; the earlier one is already in the past perfect.

explanation: When one past action is finished before another past action, the earlier one takes the past perfect ('had' + past participle) and the later one the simple past.
